list_sessions: list past model response sessions sorted newest first with optional PID exclusion
restore_session: restore a past conversation session from a log file into an agent's backend history
reset_conversation: abort current work and clear all frontend-visible conversation state for an agent
handle_continue_command: dispatch /continue or /continue N slash commands to list or restore sessions
install_continue_handler: monkey-patch a class _handle_slash_cmd method to handle /continue commands
